title: How to build an emergency preparedness kit for under $25
description:
Preparing for an emergency can start with just a few essentials. 🎒

This Emergency Preparedness Month, we’re showing how you can build an emergency kit for under $25 with practical items to help you and your household be better prepared.

Start with what you can and build from there. Every step toward preparedness matters.

#EmergencyPreparednessMonth #ReadyLACounty #EmergencyPreparedness #LACounty
